notes:
冷启动闪屏时序修复：原生壳与 App 主题对齐
1. Android：改外观立刻持久化 UiModeManager；Web 就绪前 keep-on-screen，减少系统色闪一下。
2. Windows：按 boot 设窗口主题后再显示；hydrate 后 show，减轻深色系统 + 浅色 App 黑闪。
3. iOS：更早涂 WebView/窗口底色；运行时改外观经 AppearanceBoot 同步（系统≠App 时 Launch 仍可能跟系统一帧）。

notes_en:
Cold-start flash timing fix: align native chrome with App appearance
1. Android: Persist UiModeManager as soon as appearance changes; keep splash on-screen until Web is ready.
2. Windows: Apply boot theme before showing the window; show after hydrate to reduce dark-OS / light-app black flash.
3. iOS: Apply WebView/window chrome earlier; AppearanceBoot syncs runtime overrides (Launch may still follow OS for one frame when system ≠ App).
